description: This file implements the HttpFactory class which provides factory methods for creating instances of PSR-7 HTTP message components such as requests, responses, streams, uploaded files, and URIs. It centralizes the creation logic for these objects following the PSR-17 interfaces in the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 package.

classes.name: HttpFactory
classes.description: Implements all of the PSR-17 factory interfaces to generate HTTP message objects such as requests, responses, streams, uploaded files, server requests, and URIs.

methods.name: createUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates an UploadedFile instance from a stream, setting optional size, error, filename, and media type.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream from a string content.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a stream from a file, opening it with the specified mode.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a stream from a PHP resource.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a server request object with specified method, URI, and server parameters.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a response object with status code and reason phrase.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates an HTTP request with the specified method and URI.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a URI object from a string.
